maya (PM): RFC draft for Security PRD: KMS/HSM integration, audit log model, and retention policy. Need acceptance criteria for SOC2 scoping. Quick sync? (spec draft: https://rfd.internal/1234)

omar (eng): Saw this. I can draft the runtime KMS integration section. Are we supporting customer-managed keys only for Private, or Dedicated too?

kevin (security): Prefer both. CMK for Private + Dedicated. Hosted should support server-side keys with optional BYOK. Acceptance criteria idea: key rotation support w/ zero downtime, full key-use audit events, and rotation logs retained.

lia (legal): From compliance: SOC2 will require detailed access logs, key-usage records, and retention policy. Some customers will ask for immutability and certified deletion proof for GDPR.

sara (infra): We should capture 3 audit streams: control-plane (console/api), data-plane (inference metadata), and key-ops. Proposal: append-only S3 buckets with Object Lock + a searchable index (lake) for quick queries.

maya (PM): Draft acceptance criteria (proposal):
- Audit logs: writes are durably stored to append-only store within 5s.
- Queryable: events searchable within 15 minutes.
- Retention: tenant-configurable (default 90d; presets: 90d / 1y / 7y).
- KMS: support AWS KMS + HSM (on-prem) for Dedicated/Private.
- SOC2 artifacts: monthly exportable evidence bundle (signed manifests).

tom (cust-succ): Customer asks: need a 'no-export' flag and verifiable deletion proof for GDPR/CCPA. Also want chained timestamps for request custody.

omar (eng): Edge cases to call out in PRD:
- High QPS logging (10k rps) must not increase inference tail latency. Use async fanout + sampling for debug logs.
- Log sink failure: fallback to local encrypted disk queue with TTL and backpressure mitigation.
- Cross-region replication for long-retention tenants.

kevin (security): Security edge cases:
- Key compromise scenario: automated rotation + cache invalidation plan. Acceptance criterion: KV caches must invalidate within 2s of rotation event.
- Replay protection for cached responses tied to rotated keys.

maya (PM): Scope negotiation suggestion for M1 launch: ship hosted with server-side managed keys + default audit logs (90d). Dedicated/Private BYOK + long-retention (1y/7y) targeted for Phase 2. This reduces scope for initial release while covering most customers. Need signoff from Sales & Legal.

lia (legal): Agreed. I'll prepare a contract clause template for BYOK, retention SLAs, and audit access.

sara (infra): I'll add infra checklist items into the PRD: S3 Object Lock policy, lifecycle rules for retention tiers, KMS IAM roles and least-privilege bindings, HSM network isolation pattern, and export API endpoints.

deploy-bot: created rfc/security-kms-audit-retention/draft-1 at https://rfd.internal/1234

maya (PM): Thanks all. Action items: Omar - runtime KMS section by Tue; Sara - infra checklist; Lia - contract clause draft; Kevin - security acceptance criteria and rotation playbook; I'll consolidate into PRD and recirculate for review. :thumbsup:

(Conversation end)
